reviews.text: Been taking my dog here most weekdays for about a month, and I am really impressed. Staff comes to greet you immediately once you walk in and they are very quick to bring your dog back to you. The staff I've met and spoken to: Keith, Sophie, Alexa, and Brandon have all been super nice and caring. And the prices are extremely reasonable. Highly recommend.

This place is TERRIBLE ! I live across the street and they literally leave the dogs outside the entire time. The dogs bark loudly day and night because no one tends to them.

They never walk them either. Avoid at all costs!

I just started taking my dog here about 2 weeks ago and I am so grateful I found this place. My puppy is 7 months old, very high energy, and LOVES to play with other dogs.

I love that they are continuously monitoring the play between dogs, making them take breaks when they need to, and my puppy loves the staff there! He’s practically jumping out of the car when he sees the staff walking up to greet us at the car.

Everyone is so friendly & I am so grateful I found a place I feel safe leaving my puppy to play with other dogs while I’m at work and it’s actually affordable! I wouldn’t be able to afford much more so just the fact that they have such affordable prices for such a great facility and staff makes me so happy.

Absolutely amazing place! I highly reccomend. My dog, Maddox, is typically very skiddish when it comes to people. Before we adopted him I'm guessing he wasn't very well socialized. Maddox loves the entire staff at canines unleashed.

They come out if they can to pick up your dog, and Maddox runs into daycare. Our typically very clingy dog doesnt even look back! You can't fake that.

Also around the holidays they take photos with your dog in bunny ears for easter or like a reindeer around Christmas. My fiance loves them. We will drop him off just to get a framed photo of Maddox dressed up. She keeps the pictures on a shelf.

There are cameras so if you want to take a look you can see your dog playing with other puppies, following the employees around or drinking from the water. You never have to worry if your dog is OK.

Our dog means the world to us, and Maddox loves canines unleashed. Therefore he will always come back.
My dog is taken care by the employees and they’re wonderful understanding people!!!

I had such a wonderful experience at Canine Unleashed! From the moment I walked in, it was clear how much the staff truly care about the dogs in their care. My pup was so happy the entire time!! It honestly made my day.
As a first time daycare user, I was feeling a bit nervous about leaving my baby, but the team was incredibly reassuring and communicative throughout the day. They even sent me pictures in the morning of him making friends. I especially loved being able to check in through the live cameras! it gave me so much peace of mind and was so fun to watch all the dogs playing and getting lots of love and attention.

When we got home, my dog was completely pooped (in the best way!), which says it all. I’m beyond impressed with the level of care and service here, and we’ll definitely be back soon. I can’t wait for my pup to have another amazing day

I loved that they require a temperament test before boarding or daycare to make sure dogs get along well. When I asked about availability for an official daycare drop off, they said I could drop off anytime. The whole process from the temperament test to drop off was simple and smooth, which I really appreciated!

Thank you so much canine unleashed for the love 🤍

Bad first impression.
Staff could not tell me schedule availability over the phone.
I stopped by in-person to check out the location, and the woman who greeted me was kind, but still unable to answer questions about scheduling.
As I was exiting to sit in my car to figure out evaluation availability, I heard a large dog bark outside and a woman yell, “SHUT UP!” to the dog who was barking.
Needless to say, my dog will not return to get yelled at by impatient caretakers.
Seems like they have areas of opportunity for improvement.
Be cautious if considering this location for your fur baby.
great service. doggy is happy!
This dog daycare opens very early, which is extremely convenient.

I'm concern about your employees because I saw one of them had their hand all bandaged up and she told me it was from handling the dogs. It looked like she broke her fingers. I just hope that your future employees are taken care of.
I think you should get a new microwave.

I can’t even begin to say how grateful I am for this business. Erika and her team have gone above and beyond to accommodate my beautiful boy. They do such a great job at taking care of these dogs and I love the idea that I can just check in on my pup at any time during the day. Thank you so much.

I cannot express how much I appreciate the owners and staff of Canines Unleashed, but I'm going to try. I used to live in the Talmadge neighborhood and my place of employment is located down the street from this location. My wife and I bring our dog, Xena, for daycare and she always has the best time! She is always excited to go to daycare and she is pooped when she comes home (makes for an easy night for moms!). We have been bringing her to this location for just shy of a year now, and since then she's had numerous sleep overs (which are reasonably priced) and a few baths from them (also reasonably priced). Also in that period of time, we moved to the Chula Vista area. Despite having another daycare located a few blocks from our house, we refuse to take her to any other daycare because of how much she loves it here.

One positive experience I want to share: while Xena was having a sleep over, our cat had an emergency and needed to go to the pet hospital overnight. We needed to have Xena stay one night longer unexpectedly. Without hesitation Keith and Erica had her stay longer and even went out to buy her extra food because we only packed enough for her planned stay. Usually on Sundays they're closed, but they let us do an after hours pick up on that rare occasion.

It is so reassuring to know that Canines Unleashed will be there in a pinch if we have a family emergency. They are such great people. This business is top notch!

**EDIT on 3/19/2025: a few things I need to add and clarify. Since the time I wrote my initial review several years ago, Canines Unleashed has opened their hours on Sundays, which is incredibly helpful all around! Secondly, I have not stopped taking my dog to this location! We cannot see her going to any other daycare besides here. They have since expanded their staff, all of whom take very good care of the pups. Lastly, the time since writing my initial review, I've obviously had the time to research other dog daycares in different areas. Canines Unleashed cannot be beat in regards to their affordability. You get well beyond what you pay for, and I sincerely appreciate them for it!

Our pups love Canines Unleashed! This has been our go-to daycare for 1.5 years and their staff take good care of our two dogs. We utilize their half-day daycare passes and sometimes overnight boarding. I would recommend it to anyone in the area who needs a place to take their dogs periodically.

Canines Unleashed is the only place I trust to take care of my doggo. The staff are wonderful and care for the dogs like they are their own. I see my dog, Bonita, running around having fun all day. Highly recommend to anyone looking for a safe place for their dogs during the day

Our dog loves going to daycare and boarding here! She has separation anxiety so having a reliable and professional daycare has made a huge difference for her and us. The cage free boarding is a good fit for her and she enjoys the other dogs (from what I see in the photos)

My family want on a VK to San Diego for a couple of days. Saturday was our time we be busy. I was worried about leaving my pup pup in the hotel room. So I look up at daycare for dogs and they were the first to come up. It's was his very first time my dog 🐕 try out a daycare. I was worried about him being in a new place that he never try before. I call when they open told me they take him with no problem. Especially on a Saturday. And they have a Dog Cam Live to how they doing and when I saw he was having so much fun I felt so happy and relieved just a happy dog  mommy. Pick him up, so tired from all the play play and making new friends he made. The woman I talk to on the phone was sweet and nice, felt good energy from her. When I got there were so nice and friendly and welcoming. I would 100% bring my pup pup here again

Amazing doggie daycare! They take such good care of the pups! Our Josie loved coming here. She would jump out of the car and sprint into the facility. They are so loving and kind. She was absolutely spoiled! I highly recommend Canines Unleashed!
The staff is so friendly and helpful. My dog is an anxious one and watching him on camera he looked comfortable and getting out of his shell.
Flexible and caring 👍🏼 …
The owners and staff here are amazing and truly care about dogs.
Very accommodating and Astro loves to visit.

I love that the dogs get to play off leash while they’re here, and my dog comes home happy. They have cameras where you can see the dogs (with one blind spot). The staff is great and always friendly and helpful. The only thing I don’t love is that my dog comes home stinky. I think it’s just from all the dog slobber from playing, and maybe from occasionally stepping in a pee puddle before the staff has the chance to clean it. Overall, this is a great place to take your dog for daycare or boarding.
